title: How do you run algos with prop firms?
author: StefanLen
selftext:
Hi, does anyone here use their own non-HFT futures algo with a prop firm?

I’m trying to understand the practical setup. Does it usually run through NinjaTrader, or is another platform/API used?

I’m mainly interested in firms that allow automation from evaluation through funded/live accounts.

Thanks for any real-world experience.

comments.author: jaw_line
comments.body: I’m about at the same point, I have something that is about at the stage where I’m ready to at least try prop firm execution before full deployment

comments.author: Superr_rr
comments.body: Meta trader 5 is what a lot of firms use, some allow the use of automation also know as an EA on MT5, that would be the best way, also many prop firms do not allow holding a trade overnight so that must also be looked into especially if your trade frequency is low
